name: Fee Reimbursement Scheme (Other Backward Classes), Uttar Pradesh
provider: Backward Classes Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh

rules.quote: Students belonging to Other Backward Classes studying in all the government schools, aided and recognized educational institutes of the state
Native and under study in Uttar Pradesh.
Annual income of parents/guardian of the student is upto Rs. 2 Lakh.

rules.value: cut-off merit of last year's marks, budget-limited
rules.quote: based on the Cut-Off merit of marks percentage of last year (upto the budget availability), are eligible.
This scheme is fully aided by the state government.

amount.text: Maximum annual fee reimbursement: Group-1 Rs 50,000; Group-2 Rs 30,000; Group-3 Rs 20,000; Group-4 Rs 10,000
amount.quote: Group-3	All graduate level courses which are not included in Group-I and II, like B.A., B. Sc. and B. Com./B.T.C etc. 	Rs. 20,000/-

deadline.text: Online application opens 01 July each year on scholarship.up.gov.in; disbursed 02 October and 26 January
deadline.quote: Online application by the students is started with effect from 01 July.
